question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=4{x}_{2}(t)+3,\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=$  {{field-1}} $,\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=\frac{3-2s}{s(s-4)}$ .
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{2{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{4{x}_{2}(t)+3\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=2L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+L\{{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=4L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}+3L\{1\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-1=2{X}_{1}(s)+{X}_{2}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)+2=4{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{3}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the second equation for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)+2 & =4{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =-2+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-4){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-2s+3}{s} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{3-2s}{s(s-4)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the first equation and solving for ${X}_{1}(s)$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-1 & =2{X}_{1}(s)+{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =1+{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =1+(\frac{3-2s}{s(s-4)}) \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{s(s-4)+3-2s}{s(s-4)} \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}-4s+3-2s}{s(s-4)} \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}-6s+3}{s(s-4)} \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}-6s+3}{s(s-4)(s-2)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{{s}^{2}-6s+3}{s(s-2)(s-4)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{3-2s}{s(s-4)}.
$$
